what_happened_next.text: Netflix and the US share basket more than doubled over five years. Amazon nearly doubled, but Disney finished only slightly higher. The bond estimate fell a little. This starting date came after a sharp market fall, so it gives a different picture from buying before the outbreak.

reflection.what_people_were_focused_on: The pandemic had closed venues and changed daily life. Companies hired workers, adjusted services and tried to cope with sudden demand changes.
reflection.what_actually_mattered: The starting price mattered as well as the company. Gains measured from this month do not erase losses suffered by someone who bought earlier.
reflection.what_faded_away: A hiring plan or busy streaming service did not translate into a guaranteed stock return. Business activity and share prices are connected, but not identical.
reflection.what_nobody_knew: The length of the disruption, the recovery and later interest rates were uncertain. The final chart leaves out how hard it felt to make choices then.
